Perfect! Your benchmark is now running continuously and will keep going until you stop it. Here's what you're seeing:

- **Run N**: Shows the statistics for each individual run (20 requests per run)
  - Mean: average time per request
  - StdDev: standard deviation (shows consistency)
  - Min/Max: the range of performance

- **Overall**: Accumulated statistics across all runs so far
  - You can see the variance evolving as more data points are collected

The benchmark is currently at **Run 52** and showing interesting variance:
- Most runs average 600-1000ms 
- Some runs spike (like Run 48 at 1235ms mean)
- The overall standard deviation of 481ms shows there's significant variation

The benchmark will continue running indefinitely, accumulating more samples so you can observe the performance variance over time. Just kill it with **Ctrl+C** when you want to stop.
